verdict.rationale: Notte's first-party docs include a guide for running OpenAI's Computer Use Agent (CUA) on Notte's browser infrastructure, so screenshot-based computer-use is a documented path. Nothing shows a native vision or computer-use mode in Notte's own agent that a developer can toggle, and the integration relies on an external model with an unclear developer-side loop. missing for 10: a native switchable vision/CUA action mode, screenshot-action primitives documented in depth, evidence it handles canvases or non-DOM UIs, independent hands-on corroboration.
